$description: LEAPWare Dark. Same three inputs, dark polarity. The step-1 pane is a dark grey rather than black and step 12 is an off-white rather than white; both are APCA-driven judgements that WCAG 2.x would have let us get away with ignoring. See design/README.md.

base.$description: Slightly more chroma than the light theme: at low lightness a completely neutral grey reads as flat, and the tint is what stops the pane stack looking like four shades of the same nothing.

accent.$description: Hue held identical to the light theme so that a user switching themes does not experience it as a different product. CHANGED 2026-08-04 from hue 252 / chroma 0.145 to petrol, in step with the light theme; the identity-preservation argument is why both moved together rather than one of them.
